verses.original: Ἀδελφοί μου μὴ ἐν προσωπολημψίαις ἔχετε τὴν πίστιν τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τῆς δόξης
verses.transliteration: Adelphoi mou mē en prosōpolēmpsiais echete tēn pistin tou Kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou tēs doxēs
verses.literal: My brothers as you hold out your faith in our glorious Lord Jesus Christ do not show favoritism
verses.literalPt: Meus irmãos, não tenhais a fé em nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, Senhor da glória, com respeitos humanos.

verses.original: Ἐὰν γὰρ εἰσέλθῃ εἰς συναγωγὴν ὑμῶν ἀνὴρ χρυσοδακτύλιος ἐν ἐσθῆτι λαμπρᾷ εἰσέλθῃ δὲ καὶ πτωχὸς ἐν ῥυπαρᾷ ἐσθῆτι
verses.transliteration: Ean gar eiselthē eis synagōgēn hymōn anēr chrysodaktylios en esthēti lampra eiselthē de kai ptōchos en rhypara esthēti
verses.literal: Suppose a man comes into your meeting wearing a gold ring and fine clothes and a poor man in shabby clothes also comes in
verses.literalPt: Pois, se entrar na vossa reunião algum homem que tem anel de ouro e com vestido esplêndido, e se entrar também um pobre com vestido sujo,

verses.original: ἐπιβλέψητε δὲ ἐπὶ τὸν φοροῦντα τὴν ἐσθῆτα τὴν λαμπρὰν καὶ εἴπητε Σὺ κάθου ὧδε καλῶς καὶ τῷ πτωχῷ εἴπητε Σὺ στῆθι ἐκεῖ ἢ Κάθου ὑπὸ τὸ ὑποπόδιόν μου
verses.transliteration: epiblepsēte de epi ton phorounta tēn esthēta tēn lampran kai eipēte Sy kathou hōde kalōs kai tō ptōchō eipēte Sy stēthi ekei ē Kathou hypo to hypopodion mou
verses.literal: If you lavish attention on the man in - fine clothes and say Here is a seat of honor but say to the poor man You must stand or Sit at my feet
verses.literalPt: e se tratardes com deferência ao que tem o vestido esplêndido e lhe disserdes: Senta-te aqui neste bom lugar, e disserdes ao pobre: Fica-te para ali em pé ou senta-te abaixo do escabelo dos meus pés,

verses.original: καὶ οὐ διεκρίθητε ἐν ἑαυτοῖς καὶ ἐγένεσθε κριταὶ διαλογισμῶν πονηρῶν
verses.transliteration: kai ou diekrithēte en heautois kai egenesthe kritai dialogismōn ponērōn
verses.literal: have you not discriminated among yourselves and become judges with evil thoughts
verses.literalPt: não fazeis, porventura, distinções entre vós mesmos e não vos tornais juízes de maus pensamentos?

verses.original: Ἀκούσατε ἀδελφοί μου ἀγαπητοί οὐχ ὁ Θεὸς ἐξελέξατο τοὺς πτωχοὺς τῷ κόσμῳ πλουσίους ἐν πίστει καὶ κληρονόμους τῆς βασιλείας ἧς ἐπηγγείλατο τοῖς ἀγαπῶσιν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Akousate adelphoi mou agapētoi ouch ho Theos exelexato tous ptōchous tō kosmō plousious en pistei kai klēronomous tēs basileias hēs epēngeilato tois agapōsin auton
verses.literal: Listen my beloved brothers Has not God chosen the poor of this world to be rich in faith and to inherit the kingdom He promised those who love Him
verses.literalPt: Escutai, meus amados irmãos. Não escolheu Deus os pobres do mundo para fazê-los ricos na fé e herdeiros do reino que ele prometeu aos que o amam?

verses.original: ὑμεῖς δὲ ἠτιμάσατε τὸν πτωχόν οὐχ οἱ πλούσιοι καταδυναστεύουσιν ὑμῶν καὶ αὐτοὶ ἕλκουσιν ὑμᾶς εἰς κριτήρια
verses.transliteration: hymeis de ētimasate ton ptōchon ouch hoi plousioi katadynasteuousin hymōn kai autoi helkousin hymas eis kritēria
verses.literal: But you have dishonored the poor Is it not the rich who oppress you and drag you into court
verses.literalPt: Vós, porém, desprezastes o pobre. Não são os ricos os que vos oprimem e os que vos arrastam perante os tribunais?

verses.original: οὐκ αὐτοὶ βλασφημοῦσιν τὸ καλὸν ὄνομα τὸ ἐπικληθὲν ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: ouk autoi blasphēmousin to kalon onoma to epiklēthen eph’ hymas
verses.literal: Are they not the ones who blaspheme the noble name by which you have been called
verses.literalPt: Não são eles os que blasfemam o bom Nome pelo qual sois chamados?

verses.original: Εἰ μέντοι νόμον τελεῖτε βασιλικὸν κατὰ τὴν γραφήν Ἀγαπήσεις τὸν πλησίον σου ὡς σεαυτόν καλῶς ποιεῖτε
verses.transliteration: Ei mentoi nomon teleite basilikon kata tēn graphēn Agapēseis ton plēsion sou hōs seauton kalōs poieite
verses.literal: If you really fulfill the royal law stated in Scripture Love your neighbor as yourself you are doing well
verses.literalPt: Se vós, porém, cumpris a lei real segundo a Escritura: Amarás ao teu próximo como a ti mesmo, fazeis bem;

verses.original: εἰ δὲ προσωπολημπτεῖτε ἁμαρτίαν ἐργάζεσθε ἐλεγχόμενοι ὑπὸ τοῦ νόμου ὡς παραβάται
verses.transliteration: ei de prosōpolēmpteite hamartian ergazesthe elenchomenoi hypo tou nomou hōs parabatai
verses.literal: But if you show favoritism you sin and are convicted by the law as transgressors
verses.literalPt: mas, se vos deixais levar de respeitos humanos, cometeis um pecado, sendo condenados pela Lei como transgressores.

verses.original: Ὅστις γὰρ ὅλον τὸν νόμον τηρήσῃ πταίσῃ δὲ ἐν ἑνί γέγονεν πάντων ἔνοχος
verses.transliteration: Hostis gar holon ton nomon tērēsē ptaisē de en heni gegonen pantōn enochos
verses.literal: Whoever keeps the whole law but stumbles at just one point is guilty of breaking all of it
verses.literalPt: Pois quem guardar a Lei toda, porém tropeçar em um só ponto tem-se tornado culpado de todos.

verses.original: ὁ γὰρ εἰπών Μὴ μοιχεύσῃς εἶπεν καί Μὴ φονεύσῃς εἰ δὲ οὐ μοιχεύεις φονεύεις δέ γέγονας παραβάτης νόμου
verses.transliteration: ho gar eipōn Mē moicheusēs eipen kai Mē phoneusēs ei de ou moicheueis phoneueis de gegonas parabatēs nomou
verses.literal: For He who said Do not commit adultery also said Do not murder If you do not commit adultery but do commit murder you have become a lawbreaker
verses.literalPt: O mesmo que disse: Não adulterarás, disse também: Não matarás. Ora, se não cometes adultério, mas és homicida, te hás tornado transgressor da Lei.

verses.original: Οὕτως λαλεῖτε καὶ οὕτως ποιεῖτε ὡς διὰ νόμου ἐλευθερίας μέλλοντες κρίνεσθαι
verses.transliteration: Houtōs laleite kai houtōs poieite hōs dia nomou eleutherias mellontes krinesthai
verses.literal: Speak and act as those who are going to be judged by the law that gives freedom
verses.literalPt: Falai de tal sorte e de tal sorte procedei como aqueles que hão de ser julgados pela lei da liberdade.

verses.original: ἡ γὰρ κρίσις ἀνέλεος τῷ μὴ ποιήσαντι ἔλεος κατακαυχᾶται ἔλεος κρίσεως
verses.transliteration: hē gar krisis aneleos tō mē poiēsanti eleos katakauchatai eleos kriseōs
verses.literal: For judgment without mercy will be shown to anyone who has not been merciful . . . Mercy triumphs over judgment
verses.literalPt: Pois o juízo é sem misericórdia para aquele que não tem usado de misericórdia; a misericórdia triunfa do juízo.

verses.original: Τί τὸ ὄφελος ἀδελφοί μου ἐὰν πίστιν λέγῃ τις ἔχειν ἔργα δὲ μὴ ἔχῃ μὴ δύναται ἡ πίστις σῶσαι αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Ti to ophelos adelphoi mou ean pistin legē tis echein erga de mē echē mē dynatai hē pistis sōsai auton
verses.literal: What good is it my brothers if someone claims to have faith but has no deeds Can such faith save him
verses.literalPt: De que serve, meus irmãos, se alguém disser que tem fé se não tiver obras? Acaso, pode essa fé salvá-lo?

verses.original: ἐὰν ἀδελφὸς ἢ ἀδελφὴ γυμνοὶ ὑπάρχωσιν καὶ λειπόμενοι τῆς ἐφημέρου τροφῆς
verses.transliteration: ean adelphos ē adelphē gymnoi hyparchōsin kai leipomenoi tēs ephēmerou trophēs
verses.literal: Suppose a brother or sister is without clothes and - daily food
verses.literalPt: Se um irmão ou uma irmã estiverem nus e necessitarem do pão quotidiano,

verses.original: εἴπῃ δέ τις αὐτοῖς ἐξ ὑμῶν Ὑπάγετε ἐν εἰρήνῃ θερμαίνεσθε καὶ χορτάζεσθε μὴ δῶτε δὲ αὐτοῖς τὰ ἐπιτήδεια τοῦ σώματος τί τὸ ὄφελος
verses.transliteration: eipē de tis autois ex hymōn Hypagete en eirēnē thermainesthe kai chortazesthe mē dōte de autois ta epitēdeia tou sōmatos ti to ophelos
verses.literal: If one of you tells him Go in peace stay warm and well fed but does not provide for . . . his physical needs what good is that
verses.literalPt: e algum de vós lhes disser: Ide em paz, aquentai-vos e saciai-vos, e não lhes derdes o que é necessário para o corpo, que lhes aproveita?

verses.original: οὕτως καὶ ἡ πίστις ἐὰν μὴ ἔχῃ ἔργα νεκρά ἐστιν καθ’ ἑαυτήν
verses.transliteration: houtōs kai hē pistis ean mē echē erga nekra estin kath’ heautēn
verses.literal: So too faith by itself if it does not result . . . in action is dead
verses.literalPt: Assim também a fé, se não tiver obras, é morta em si mesma.

verses.original: Ἀλλ’ ἐρεῖ τις Σὺ πίστιν ἔχεις κἀγὼ ἔργα ἔχω δεῖξόν μοι τὴν πίστιν σου χωρὶς τῶν ἔργων κἀγώ σοι δείξω ἐκ τῶν ἔργων μου τὴν πίστιν
verses.transliteration: All’ erei tis Sy pistin echeis kagō erga echō deixon moi tēn pistin sou chōris tōn ergōn kagō soi deixō ek tōn ergōn mou tēn pistin
verses.literal: But someone will say You have faith and I have deeds Show me your faith without deeds and I will show you my faith by my deeds
verses.literalPt: Mas alguém dirá: Tu tens fé, e eu tenho obras; mostra-me a tua fé sem as obras, e eu te mostrarei a minha fé pelas minhas obras.

verses.original: σὺ πιστεύεις ὅτι εἷς ἐστιν ὁ Θεός καλῶς ποιεῖς καὶ τὰ δαιμόνια πιστεύουσιν καὶ φρίσσουσιν
verses.transliteration: sy pisteueis hoti heis estin ho Theos kalōs poieis kai ta daimonia pisteuousin kai phrissousin
verses.literal: You believe that God is one Good for you Even the demons believe that and shudder
verses.literalPt: Crês tu que Deus é um só? Fazes bem; os demônios também o creem e estremecem.

verses.original: Θέλεις δὲ γνῶναι ὦ ἄνθρωπε κενέ ὅτι ἡ πίστις χωρὶς τῶν ἔργων ἀργή ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: Theleis de gnōnai ō anthrōpe kene hoti hē pistis chōris tōn ergōn argē estin
verses.literal: O foolish man do you want evidence that faith without deeds is worthless
verses.literalPt: Mas queres saber, ó homem vão, que a fé sem as suas obras é estéril?

verses.original: Ἀβραὰμ ὁ πατὴρ ἡμῶν οὐκ ἐξ ἔργων ἐδικαιώθη ἀνενέγκας Ἰσαὰκ τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον
verses.transliteration: Abraam ho patēr hēmōn ouk ex ergōn edikaiōthē anenenkas Isaak ton huion autou epi to thysiastērion
verses.literal: Was not our father Abraham justified by what he did when he offered his son Isaac on the altar
verses.literalPt: Não foi pelas obras que Abraão, nosso pai, foi justificado, quando ofereceu a seu filho Isaque sobre o altar?

verses.original: βλέπεις ὅτι ἡ πίστις συνήργει τοῖς ἔργοις αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἔργων ἡ πίστις ἐτελειώθη
verses.transliteration: blepeis hoti hē pistis synērgei tois ergois autou kai ek tōn ergōn hē pistis eteleiōthē
verses.literal: You see that his faith was working with his actions and his faith was perfected by what he did
verses.literalPt: Vês que a fé cooperou com as suas obras e que pelas suas obras a fé foi consumada,

verses.original: καὶ ἐπληρώθη ἡ γραφὴ ἡ λέγουσα Ἐπίστευσεν δὲ Ἀβραὰμ τῷ Θεῷ καὶ ἐλογίσθη αὐτῷ εἰς δικαιοσύνην καὶ φίλος Θεοῦ ἐκλήθη
verses.transliteration: kai eplērōthē hē graphē hē legousa Episteusen de Abraam tō Theō kai elogisthē autō eis dikaiosynēn kai philos Theou eklēthē
verses.literal: And the Scripture was fulfilled that says Abraham believed God and it was credited to him as righteousness and he was called a friend of God
verses.literalPt: e cumpriu-se o que diz a Escritura: E Abraão creu a Deus, e isso lhe foi imputado para justiça; e: Ele foi chamado amigo de Deus.

verses.original: ὁρᾶτε ὅτι ἐξ ἔργων δικαιοῦται ἄνθρωπος καὶ οὐκ ἐκ πίστεως μόνον
verses.transliteration: horate hoti ex ergōn dikaioutai anthrōpos kai ouk ek pisteōs monon
verses.literal: As you can see a man is justified by his deeds and not by faith alone
verses.literalPt: Vedes que é pelas obras que o homem é justificado e não somente pela fé.

verses.original: Ὁμοίως δὲ καὶ Ῥαὰβ ἡ πόρνη οὐκ ἐξ ἔργων ἐδικαιώθη ὑποδεξαμένη τοὺς ἀγγέλους καὶ ἑτέρᾳ ὁδῷ ἐκβαλοῦσα
verses.transliteration: Homoiōs de kai Rhaab hē pornē ouk ex ergōn edikaiōthē hypodexamenē tous angelous kai hetera hodō ekbalousa
verses.literal: In the same way was not even Rahab the prostitute justified by her actions when she welcomed the spies and sent them off on another route
verses.literalPt: Do mesmo modo, também não foi Raabe, a meretriz, justificada pelas obras, quando recebeu os espias e os fez partir por outro caminho?

verses.original: ὥσπερ γὰρ τὸ σῶμα χωρὶς πνεύματος νεκρόν ἐστιν οὕτως καὶ ἡ πίστις χωρὶς ἔργων νεκρά ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: hōsper gar to sōma chōris pneumatos nekron estin houtōs kai hē pistis chōris ergōn nekra estin
verses.literal: As the body without the spirit is dead so - faith without deeds is dead
verses.literalPt: Pois, assim como o corpo sem espírito é morto, assim também a fé sem obras é morta.
